scope: Cell-spawn boot-interval attribution per harness, one instrumented production spawn each, captured 2026-09-21 with scripts/perf/boot-trace.mjs (proc/net/runner-file/hived.log poll, 2ms proc / 5ms socket / 2ms file on Linux; ps+netstat loop ~30ms on macOS) plus scripts/perf/harness-boot.mjs standalone handshake profiles. Anchor is the daemon cmd.spawn log line; all offsets are microseconds after it. This is a segment-SHARE attribution, not an idle-host latency baseline: netcup-1 was idle (load 0.5-1.3), metal-1 and the Studio were loaded (load 4-9) and their totals are inflated. Clocks are never subtracted across hosts. Raw traces under .proof/boot-attribution/ (uncommitted).
anchorNote: cmd.spawn -> booted(accept-ready). For codex/grok/kimi/opencode booted is the harness handshake result (thread/start or session/new). For claude (readyAtSpawn) booted is the synthetic accept-open at agent-pid confirmation; claude emits its own system/init only on the first turn, so its provider init/model cost is a turn cost, not a boot cost.

nodeKinds.metal-1: satellite ext4 raid (EPYC 9454P), also runs CI actions-runners

availability.grok: netcup-1, Studio (metal-1 has no grok account leased)
availability.kimi: Studio only (OAuth-only; refused leasing to satellites; no kimi account on netcup-1 or metal-1)
availability.opencode: not spawnable as a Honeybee Cell bee anywhere: no builtin opencode agent/adapter (config.ts BUILTIN_AGENTS has claude/codex/grok/kimi/agy); the Studio's config `agents.opencode` points at a deleted shim; netcup-1 has opencode accounts but its ~/.local/share/opencode is root-owned (EACCES). Measured standalone-ACP + binary floor only.

physicalFloorsUs.note: github_rtt is pre-spawn Apiary materialization, OUTSIDE the owner boot window; provider_rtt lands inside stage E (harness auth/model/session).

A_provisioning.what: git-image CoW (workstation) or `git clone --local` (satellite) + `git checkout` of the working tree (8 workers) + hygiene/warm
A_provisioning.floor: disk-bound by tracked file count; honeybee repo = 3915 files

B_runner_host_start.what: detached runner-host node process up to status.g1 hostPid

C_sandbox_wrap.what: bwrap/seatbelt exec then harness binary exec

D_harness_initialize.what: binary load + home/config read + MCP client init up to the initialize result

E_session_thread_start.what: auth/credential check, model/limits fetch, thread/session start; includes >=1 provider RTT (~100ms)

F_booted_detection.detail: 25ms booting-tick + 50ms runner-file pump; event-driven observation would cut this

codex/netcup-1.note: first spawn against a freshly GitHub-fetched origin (cold page cache): checkout ~985ms. Harness handshake initialize->booted ~663ms incl provider TLS.

claude/netcup-1.note: warm origin, checkout ~310ms. Accept-ready at 475ms; claude's own init/model is deferred to the first turn.

grok/studio.note: loaded host; grok booted inflated under load.

opencode/studio-standalone.note: standalone ACP only (not a Honeybee bee). initialize ~531ms after exec; session/new ~1166ms more.

conclusion.largest_common_honeybee_segment: A_provisioning (git checkout of the working tree): warm ~296-462ms, cold-cache ~985ms on netcup ext4, ~616-675ms on the loaded Studio CoW path. Present for every harness. This is the warm-pool / pre-provisioned-cell target.
conclusion.second: F_booted_detection ~75ms (25ms tick + 50ms pump), universal and cheap to remove with event-driven observation.
conclusion.harness_owned_not_honeybees: D+E (binary load + initialize + session/thread start + auth/model + provider RTT): codex ~357-663ms, grok ~800ms, kimi ~721ms, claude ~0 at boot. Provider RTT (~100ms) is the floor and is the provider's own network latency. Lazier MCP does not help boot: codex/grok MCP startupStatus arrives AFTER booted.
